{{Quote|Target's dead ahead, General. But I don't think we brought ''nearly'' enough troopers...''"<br />"''Not like you to be so ''dramatic'', Rex. You're leading a battle-hardened unit, supported by ''Juggernauts, commandos'' and two ''Jedi''!|[[Rex/Legends|Rex]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="Burn the Behemoth!" />}}
During a '''battle''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]], near the outskirts of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Thousand Thousand]], a [[Legion/Legends|legion]] of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] attacked and destroyed the ''[[Bogg Behemoth]]'', a huge [[Tank/Legends|tank]] manned by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Bogg]]. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] led the Republic forces in the attack.
